title: Copilot plugin-only customizations, GPT-6.2, /code-review
summary: In short: [Control where GitHub Copilot customizations come from](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-11-16-control-where-github-copilot-customizations-come-from/): Enterprise administrators can now require skills, custom agents, hooks, MCP servers and executable Copilot extensions to come from plugins or managed settings, for all five categories or only some. The `strictPluginOnlyCustomization` managed setting then blocks standalone customizations from user and project sources. It works on GitHub Enterprise Cloud for Copilot Business and Enterprise licenses. On 2026-11-18, team customizations became generally available: team maintainers and organization owners can pick approved plugins as team defaults. [GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol in Work and Codex](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/changelog#codex-gpt-62-astra): GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol are available in ChatGPT Work and Codex. OpenAI suggests Astra for the hardest projects and Sol for everyday coding. GitHub made both generally available in Copilot the same day for Pro+, Max, Business and Enterprise. Codex 0.171.0 (2026-11-20) adds them to its model catalogs, with Sol as the default selection. [Claude Code v2.1.328](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.328): `/code-review` now reports only bugs and CLAUDE.md violations on most models; `/simplify` takes the reuse, simplification and efficiency cleanups. v2.1.329 (2026-11-19) fixes `/code-review` stopping at a permission prompt, on most models, to look for a `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` that doesn't exist.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.326
items.text: Added support for turning on Code Mode while agent teams are enabled; if you already turned it on, sessions with teams on now start in Code Mode

items.title: Control where GitHub Copilot customizations come from
items.text: As an enterprise administrator, you can now require selected GitHub Copilot customizations to come from plugins or managed settings, rather than standalone user or project configuration.

items.title: GitHub Copilot models deprecated on November 16, 2026
items.text: As of today, November 16, 2026, we have deprecated the following models across most GitHub Copilot experiences (including Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions).

items.title: VS Code retires the Local harness in February 2027
items.text: Visual Studio Code 1.146 deprecates the Local harness, the older software that coordinates the model, context, and tools for GitHub Copilot agent sessions in the editor. The Local harness will be removed in February 2027.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.327
items.text: Added a confirmation before `/install-github-app` changes a repository

items.title: GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol in Work and Codex
items.text: GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol are now available in ChatGPT Work and Codex.

items.title: Copilot code review: Adaptive effort, secret detection, and more
items.text: Adaptive matches review depth to each pull request, so routine changes get a quick pass and risky changes get a deeper look.

items.title: GitHub Copilot app, Microsoft Ignite releases
items.text: The GitHub Copilot app now supports your Azure DevOps repositories, your GitHub Enterprise Server instance, and the browser you’re already signed in to.

items.title: GitHub Copilot benchmarks site adds harness comparisons
items.text: The new Harnesses view compares GitHub Copilot CLI with Claude Code and Codex CLI using the same model at the same reasoning effort.

items.title: GitHub Copilot CLI adds Microsoft Entra sign-in as a preview
items.text: GitHub Copilot CLI now supports Microsoft Entra authentication in public preview.

items.title: GitHub Copilot Evals is now in public preview
items.text: You can now use GitHub Copilot Evals to optimize GitHub Copilot for yourself.

items.title: GitHub Copilot Fusion updates: more availability, benchmarks, and models
items.text: Today, we’re expanding GitHub Copilot Fusion with new models, available on more Copilot surfaces, and results on two public Terminal-Bench leaderboards, giving you more ways to use Fusion and compare its performance.

items.title: GitHub Copilot in JetBrains, Ignite releases
items.text: This update brings remote access, on-device voice dictation, and browser use controls to GitHub Copilot for JetBrains.

items.title: Let GitHub Copilot interact with your browser
items.text: Paired with the GitHub Copilot Chrome extension, browser use is now available in public preview in GitHub Copilot CLI, GitHub Copilot app, VS Code and JetBrains.

items.title: MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash in GitHub Copilot
items.text: The next generation of Microsoft AI (MAI) coding models has arrived in GitHub Copilot.

items.title: Monitor GitHub Copilot activity through Microsoft Agent 365
items.text: Enterprises can now stream GitHub Copilot agent activity directly into Microsoft Agent 365.

items.title: OpenAI’s GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol now available
items.text: OpenAI’s GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol are now generally available in GitHub Copilot.

items.title: Secret scanning on demand for developers and agents
items.text: Copilot’s security review specialist now runs GitHub secret scanning, so developers and agents can catch secrets in code changes before they’re merged.

items.title: Track Copilot code review outcomes in Repository insights
items.text: You can now see how Copilot code review feedback lands in each repository.

items.title: Upcoming deprecation of MAI-Code-1.1-Flash in December
items.text: With the launch of MAI Code 2 Flash, we will deprecate MAI-Code-1.1-Flash across all GitHub Copilot experiences on December 18, 2026

items.title: ChatGPT for iOS 1.2026.314
items.text: Side chats are now saved on compatible paired computers, so you can reopen them later from the original task.

items.title: Codex 0.170.0
items.text: Added experimental support for using identically named MCP servers across environments.

items.title: Connect Supabase, Box, Calendly, and more to Copilot
items.text: You can now connect eight more services to Copilot using GitHub-verified MCP servers, or connectors, available in public preview.

items.title: Customize GitHub Copilot for your team
items.text: You can now share the GitHub Copilot plugins your team relies on without asking every member to repeat the same setup. Team customizations are generally available for organization teams.

items.title: Gemini 4 Neon in GitHub Copilot
items.text: Gemini 4 Neon is now generally available in GitHub Copilot.

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.328
items.text: Changed `/code-review` on most models to report only bugs and CLAUDE.md violations; run `/simplify` for reuse, simplification and efficiency cleanups

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.329
items.text: Added a trust dialog warning that says where a folder's hooks are declared

items.title: Gemini CLI v0.69.0
items.text: feat(cli): add /stats heatmap subcommand for daily token usage

items.title: Gemini CLI v0.70.0
items.text: fix(cli): skip system MCP servers with insecure command permissions

items.title: Claude Code v2.1.330
items.text: Added sign-in to organizations managed in Anthropic's Enterprise Admin Console: after `claude auth login`, Claude Code applies the organization's settings and uses its cloud provider or gateway

items.title: Codex 0.171.0
items.text: Added GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra to model catalogs, with Sol as the default catalog selection.
